response: For the initial per-task unit, dispatch exactly two fresh generic agents because no Superpowers typed role is advertised; do not request an unavailable sp_implementer_* or sp_code_reviewer role. Implementation: spawn_agent with task_name=implement_task_1, agent_type=worker, fork_turns=none, model=gpt-5.6-terra, and a filled implementer-prompt.md message. Review: only after DONE/DONE_WITH_CONCERNS has been routed and a review package for the recorded BASE..HEAD exists, spawn_agent with task_name=review_task_1, agent_type=explorer, fork_turns=none, model=gpt-5.6-terra, and a filled task-reviewer-prompt.md message. worker is the advertised generic execution role; explorer is the advertised read-only codebase-analysis role. Explicit model selection is required in this untyped fallback, and gpt-5.6-terra is the standard/mid-tier choice for an ordinary prose-specified task and its task-sized review; a mechanical, integration-heavy, or architectural task would require the baseline's corresponding cheaper or more capable explicit model. The implementation prompt must cover one-line project fit, the task brief path as the sole source of exact requirements, only necessary prior-task interfaces/decisions, task-relevant Context7 findings or the exact NONE declaration, ambiguity resolutions, work directory, report path and report contract, tests/TDD evidence where required, commit, self-review, escalation statuses, and the instruction not to guess. The review prompt must cover the same brief path, binding global constraints copied verbatim, report path, BASE SHA, HEAD SHA, review-package path, absolute Superpowers directory, read-only/no-crawl limits, no routine test rerun, and both required verdicts: spec compliance and task quality. The ledger must already begin '# SDD ledger — plan: <PLAN_FILE>'. No completion line is written merely for dispatch. On a clean review append 'Task 1: complete (commits <base7>..<head7>, review clean)'; ledger deferred Minors before that and point the final whole-branch reviewer to them. Critical/Important findings or confirmed spec gaps start the bounded fix/re-review loop instead. The missing typed roles are not a human-stop condition. Counts below cover this initial implement-plus-task-review unit only; the mandatory final whole-branch review occurs after all plan tasks and is outside this unit.

prompt_coverage: one-line project fit
task brief path introduced as the requirements and sole home of exact values
only necessary prior-task interfaces and decisions
task-relevant Context7 findings plus DO_NOT_REQUERY_CONTEXT7, or NONE — no external API/library uncertainty for this task
controller resolutions of brief ambiguities
working directory
report path and full report/short return contract
tests and TDD evidence when required
commit and self-review requirements
DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, BLOCKED, and NEEDS_CONTEXT routing

proposed_events.precondition: Implementer report routed and review package generated from the task's recorded BASE through HEAD
prompt_coverage: same task brief path
binding global constraints copied verbatim
implementer report path
BASE SHA and HEAD SHA
review package path containing commits, stat, and full contextual diff
absolute Superpowers directory for specialist checklist resolution
read-only task-scoped review and focused-risk inspection limits
no routine re-run of implementer tests
spec-compliance verdict including cannot-verify items
Critical, Important, and Minor quality findings with evidence
task-quality Approved or Needs fixes verdict

proposed_events.on_blocking_finding: Do not mark complete; enter the bounded implementer-fix and scoped-re-review loop and append each round in the required Task 1: fix round R/5 form.
